title: Service Agreement Renewals for MEP Contractors: Coordinate Price Review and Customer Approval
summary: Route multi-trade service renewals through scope, pricing and customer approval before activating the next contract term.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Automating MEP service renewals means coordinating decisions about the next term, not simply copying an expiration date into a reminder. Bring together the current agreement, covered equipment and sites, service history, proposed pricing and authorized customer acceptance. Use a workflow to route the reviews and preserve the approved version. Sales can manage the conversation while contract administration controls activation and finance validates the billing terms for the new service obligation.


Explore the complete[commercial HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/commercial-mep-contractors) for the systems and processes around this guide.
